desc:
I've walked past plenty of C.A.M.P.s trying too hard to look slick and expensive, but agon024 actually pulled it off. Built inside a Corvega Showroom Structure named Neapolitan off Route 86B, it sports enough iconic statues and glowing Ultracite Shards along the roofline to make you think a Vegas high-roller relocated to Appalachia.

The ground floor features an intimidating wall of Fasnacht masks—deadbeats who couldn't cover their gambling debts, maybe? Upstairs is Valentino's: a private gaming lounge bathed in red and gold, presided over by Atlantic City's World's Largest Slot Machine, surrounded by blackjack and roulette tables.

I haven't spotted a vendor yet, nor do I know the buy-in stake, though it's well out of my price range considering I unload most of my stash for 10 caps apiece. Still, that level of structural trompe-l'œil earns a proper Fallout76er shout-out.
